mcqs.question: The number of sign bits in a 32-bit IEEE format   __________
mcqs.explanation: There is only 1 sign bit in all the standards. In a 32-bit format, there is 1 sign bit, 8 bits for the exponent and 23 bits for the mantissa.

mcqs.question: New CPU whose instruction set includes the instruction set of its predecessor CPU is said to be ___________ with its predecessor.
mcqs.explanation: The CPU is called backward compatible since it contains the instruction set of its predecessor. Manufacturers tend to group their CPUs into families having similar instruction set.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Cache Memory”.

mcqs.question: What is the high speed memory between the main memory and the CPU called?
mcqs.explanation: It is called the Cache Memory. The cache memory is the high speed memory between the main memory and the CPU.

mcqs.question: Cache Memory is implemented using the DRAM chips.
mcqs.explanation: The Cache memory is implemented using the SRAM chips and not the DRAM chips. SRAM stands for Static RAM. It is faster and is expensive.

mcqs.question: Whenever the data is found in the cache memory it is called as  _________
mcqs.explanation: Whenever the data is found in the cache memory, it is called as Cache HIT. CPU first checks in the cache memory since it is closest to the CPU.

mcqs.question: LRU stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: LRU stands for Least Recently Used. LRU is a type of replacement policy used by the cache memory.

mcqs.question: When the data at a location in cache is different from the data located in the main memory, the cache is called _____________
mcqs.explanation: The cache is said to be inconsistent. Inconsistency must be avoided as it leads to serious data bugs.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a write policy to avoid Cache Coherence?
mcqs.explanation: There is no policy which is called as the write within policy. The other three options are the write policies which are used to avoid cache coherence.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an efficient method of cache updating?
mcqs.explanation: Snoopy writes is the efficient method for updating the cache. In this case, the cache controller snoops or monitors the operations of other bus masters.

mcqs.question: In ____________ mapping, the data can be mapped anywhere in the Cache Memory.
mcqs.explanation: This happens in the associative mapping. In this case, a block of data from the main memory can be mapped anywhere in the cache memory.

mcqs.question: The number of sign bits in a 32-bit IEEE format is ____
mcqs.explanation: There is only 1 sign bit in all the standards. In a 32-bit format, there is 1 sign bit, 8 bits for the exponent and 23 bits for the mantissa.

mcqs.question: The transfer between CPU and Cache is  ______________
mcqs.explanation: The transfer is a word transfer. In the memory subsystem, word is transferred over the memory data bus and it typically has a width of a word or half-word.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Processor & Its Types”.

mcqs.question: Computer has a built-in system clock that emits millions of regularly spaced electric pulses per _____ called clock cycles.
mcqs.explanation: The regularly spaced electric pulses per second are referred to as the clock cycles. All the jobs performed by the processor are on the basis of clock cycles.

mcqs.question: It takes one clock cycle to perform a basic operation.
mcqs.explanation: It takes exactly one clock cycle to perform a basic operation, such as moving a byte of memory from a location to another location in the computer.

mcqs.question: The operation that does not involves clock cycles is _________
mcqs.explanation:
Normally, several clock cycles are required to fetch, execute and decode a particular program.
Installation of a device is done by the system on its own.

mcqs.question: The number of clock cycles per second is referred as  ________
mcqs.explanation: The number of clock cycles per second is the clock speed. It is generally measured in gigahertz(10<sup>9</sup> cycles/sec) or megahertz (10<sup>6</sup> cycles/sec).

mcqs.question: CISC stands for  ____________
mcqs.explanation: CISC is a large instruction set computer. It has variable length instructions. It also has variety of addressing modes.

mcqs.question: Which of the following processor has a fixed length of instructions?
mcqs.explanation: The RISC which stands for Reduced Instruction set computer has a fixed length of instructions. It has a small instruction set. Also has reduced references to memory to retrieve operands.

mcqs.question: Processor which is complex and expensive to produce is ________
mcqs.explanation: CISC stands for complex instruction set computer. It is mostly used in personal computers. It has a large instruction set and a variable length of instructions.

mcqs.question: The architecture that uses a tighter coupling between the compiler and the processor is ____________
mcqs.explanation: EPIC stands for Explicitly parallel instruction computing. It has a tighter coupling between the compiler and the processor. It enables the compiler to extract maximum parallelism in the original code.

mcqs.question: MAR stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: The MAR stands for memory address register. It holds the address of the active memory location.

mcqs.question: A circuitry that processes that responds to and processes the basic instructions that are required to drive a computer system is ________
mcqs.explanation: The processor is responsible for processing the basic instructions in order to drive a computer. The primary functions of a processor are fetch, decode and execute.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Main Memory Organisation”.

mcqs.question: Any electronic holding place where data can be stored and retrieved later whenever required is ____________
mcqs.explanation: Memory is the place where data can be stored and later retrieved. Memory can be of classified into register, cache, main memory, etc.

mcqs.question: Cache memory is the onboard storage.
mcqs.explanation: Cache Memory is the memory closest to the CPU. Registers, Cache and the main memory are the means of onboard storage in the computer system.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is the fastest means of memory access for CPU?
mcqs.explanation: Registers are the fastest means of access for CPU. Registers are the small memory locations which are present closest to the CPU.

mcqs.question: The memory implemented using the semiconductor chips is _________
mcqs.explanation: The main memory is implemented using semiconductor chips. Main memory is located on the motherboard. It mainly consists of RAM and small amount of ROM.

mcqs.question: Size of the ________ memory mainly depends on the size of the address bus.
mcqs.explanation: The size of the main memory depends on the size of the address bus of the CPU. The main memory mainly consists of RAM and ROM, where RAM contains the current data and programs and ROM contains permanent programs like BIOS.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is independent of the address bus?
mcqs.explanation: The secondary memory is independent of the address bus. It increases the storage space. It is implemented in the form of magnetic storage devices.

mcqs.question: ____________ storage is a system where a robotic arm will connect or disconnect off-line mass storage media according to the computer operating system demands.
mcqs.explanation: The tertiary storage is the correct option. It is used in the realms of enterprise storage and scientific computing on large computer systems and business computer networks and is something a typical personal computer never sees firsthand.

mcqs.question: What is the location of the internal registers of CPU?
mcqs.explanation: The internal registers are present on-chip. They are therefore present inside the CPU. L1 cache is also present on-chip inside the CPU.

mcqs.question: MAR stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: The MAR stands for memory address register. It holds the address of the active memory location.

mcqs.question: If M denotes the number of memory locations and N denotes the word size, then an expression that denotes the storage capacity is ______________
mcqs.explanation: Storage capacity is the product of a number of memory locations that is the number of words and the word size or the number of bits stored per location. Storage capacity should be as large as possible.

title: 7. Computer Fundamental MCQ on Secondary Storage Devices

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Sequential & Direct Access”.

mcqs.question: HLDA stands for _______
mcqs.explanation: The HOLD signal is given to the CPU whenever an interrupt is to be served. If the CPU is ready to give the control of the bus, it gives the HLDA command which is Hold Acknowledgement.

mcqs.question: Word length of a personal computer  ___________
mcqs.explanation: The word length which is the size of a word is generally 8 bits in a personal computer. Word Size is generally the number of bits that can be processed in one go by the CPU.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Magnetic Tapes”.

mcqs.question: ________________ is also called auxiliary storage.
mcqs.explanation: The secondary memory which allows us to store a large amount of data is often referred to as the auxiliary memory. It generally stores large amount of data on a permanent basis.

mcqs.question: Secondary storage virtually has an unlimited capacity because the cost per bit is very low.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true as secondary storage devices can store large amounts of data temporarily. It is used to overcome the limitations of primary storage.

mcqs.question: Magnetic tape is a type of _________ access device.
mcqs.explanation: Magnetic tapes are sequential access devices. They are the secondary storage devices and are used to store large amounts of data. In sequential access, data can be retrieved in the same sequence in which it is stored.

mcqs.question: The magnetic tape is generally a plastic ribbon coated with ______
mcqs.explanation: Plastic ribbon is coated with a magnetizable recording material. Iron oxide and chromium dioxide is generally used in magnetic tapes. Data are recorded on the tape in the form of tiny invisible dots.

mcqs.question: The dots on the magnetic tape represent ________
mcqs.explanation: The data recorded on the tape is the form of tiny invisible magnetized and non-magnetized spots (representing 1s and 0s) on its coated surface.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is the correct representation for a storage capacity of a tape?

options.a: a) Data recording density = Storage capacity
options.c: c) Storage capacity= Length * data recording density
options.d: d) Storage capacity= Length + data recording density

mcqs.answer: c) Storage capacity= Length * data recording density
mcqs.explanation: Storage capacity is nothing but the product of length and the data recording density. Magnetic tape is commonly used sequential-access secondary device. Data recording density is measured in bytes per inch.

mcqs.question: __________________ is the amount of data that can be stored on a given length of tape.
mcqs.explanation: Data recording density is the amount of data that can be stored on a given length of the tape. It is measured in bytes per inch. Bytes per inch=bpi.

mcqs.question: The number of characters/second that can be transmitted to the memory from the tape is denoted by the term.
mcqs.explanation: Transfer rate measurement unit is bytes/second(bps). Value depends on the data recording density and the speed with which the tape travels under the read/write head.

mcqs.question: The typical value of data transfer rate is __________
mcqs.explanation: Data transfer rate is defined as the number of characters per second that can be transmitted to the memory from tape. The typical value is 7.7 megabytes per second.

mcqs.question: Tape drive is connected to and controlled by _______
mcqs.explanation: The tape drive is connected to and controlled by a tape controller that interprets the commands for operating the tape drive. Certain commonly used commands are read, write, erase tape, etc.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Magnetic Disks”.

mcqs.question: ________________ is used for writing/reading of data to/from a magnetic ribbon.
mcqs.explanation: The magnetic tape ribbon is used for the same. It has read/write heads for reading/writing of data on the tape. When processing is complete, the tape is removed from the tape drive for off-line storage.

mcqs.question: Magnetic disk is a sequential access device.
mcqs.explanation: It is a direct access secondary storage device. In case of direct access devices, the storage location may be selected and accessed at random.

mcqs.question: The disk’s surface is divided into a number of invisible concentric circles called:
mcqs.explanation: The concentric circles are called as tracks. The tracks are numbered consecutively from outermost to innermost starting from zero. The number of tracks on a disk may be as few as 40 on small-capacity disks to several thousand on large capacity disks.

mcqs.question: The number of sectors per track on a magnetic disk ________
mcqs.explanation: Each track of a disk is subdivided into sectors. There are 8 or more sectors per track. Disk drives are designed to read/write only whole sectors at a time.

mcqs.question: Generally there are __________bytes in a sector.
mcqs.explanation: Each track of a disc is divided into sectors. A sector typically contains 512 bytes. Disk drives are designed to read/write only whole sectors at a time.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a part of disk address?
mcqs.explanation: Disk address represents the physical location of the record on the disk. It is comprised of the sector number, track number, and surface number (when double-sided disks are used).

mcqs.question: What does CHS stand for?
mcqs.explanation: CHS stands for cylinder-head-sector. The scheme is called CHS addressing. The same is also referred to as disk geometry.

mcqs.question: The interval between the instant a computer makes a request for the transfer of data from a disk system to the primary storage and the instance this operation is completed is called _________
mcqs.explanation: The interval is referred to as the disk arrival time. It depends on several parameters. Generally, a computer makes a request and the operation is served.

mcqs.question: Disk access time does not depends on which of the following factors __________
mcqs.explanation: The disk access time depends on the seek time, latency and transfer rate. Wherein, seek time is the time required to position the read/write head over the desired track.

mcqs.question: The time required to spin the desired sector under the read/write head, once the read/write head is positioned on the desired track.
mcqs.explanation: It is called latency. It is one of the factors on which the disk access time depends. Disk access time is the interval between the instant a request is made and the instance operation is completed.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Optical Disks”.

mcqs.question: A ____________ disk consists of a circular disk, which is coated with a thin metal or some other material that is highly reflective.
mcqs.explanation: Optical disks are highly reflective. They can be used to store extremely large amounts of data in a limited space.

mcqs.question: Optical disks are proved to be a promising random access medium for high capacity secondary storage.
mcqs.explanation: Optical disks can store large amounts of data. The storage capacity depends on the sectors and the number of bytes.

mcqs.question: The technology used in optical disks is ______
mcqs.explanation:
Laser beam technology is used in optical disks for recording or reading of data on the disk.
It is sometimes called the laser disk/optical laser disk due to the use of laser beam technology.

mcqs.question: The storage capacity of an optical disk is given by:

options.a: a) Number of sectors * number of bytes per sector
options.b: b) Number of sectors * 2(number of bytes per sector)
options.c: c) Number of sectors * 3(number of bytes per sector)
options.d: d) Number of sectors * 0.5(number of bytes per sector)

mcqs.answer: a) Number of sectors * number of bytes per sector
mcqs.explanation: The storage capacity is given by the formula in option a. The most popular disk uses a disk of 5.25 inch diameter with a storage capacity of around 650 megabytes.

mcqs.question: Rotation of the disk must vary __________ with the radius of the disk.
mcqs.explanation:
The rotation speed is inversely proportional to the radius of the disk.
Optical drives use a constant linear velocity encoding scheme often referred to as the CLV scheme.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly represents the track pattern of an optical disk  ?

options.a: a)
options.b: b)
options.c: c)
options.d: d)

mcqs.answer: a)
mcqs.explanation: Option a correctly represents the track pattern of an optical disk. The second option shows the track pattern of a magnetic disk. The last two options are invalid.

mcqs.question: The tracks are divided into sectors whose size _______
mcqs.explanation: The tracks in an optical disk are divided into equal size sectors. Optical disk has one long spiral track, which starts at the outer edge and spirals inward to the center. Each sector is of the same length regardless of whether it is located near or away from the disk’s center.

mcqs.question: CLV stands for, in terms of rotation of the optical disk ___
mcqs.explanation: It stands for constant linear velocity. The optical disk uses the CLV encoding scheme. Rotation speed depends on the radius of the disk.

mcqs.question: The range of access times of optical disks is generally ______
mcqs.explanation: The access times of optical disks are typically in the range of 100 to 300 milliseconds and that of hard disks are in the range of 10 to 30 milliseconds.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a type of optical disk?
mcqs.explanation: The Winchester disk is a type of hard disk. Others are all optical disks. WORM is nothing but CD-R i.e., CD recordable. Stands for write once read many.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Memory Storage Devices”.

mcqs.question: Winchester disks are a type of   _______
mcqs.explanation: The regularly spaced electric pulses per second are referred to as the clock cycles. All the jobs performed by the processor are on the basis of clock cycles.

mcqs.question: Bernoulli disks are a type of magnetic floppy disks.
mcqs.explanation: Bernoulli disks are a type of magnetic hard disks and not floppy disks. They are also called as zip disks. It uses a single hard disk platter encased in a plastic cartidge.

mcqs.question: A plug and play storage device that simply plugs in the port of a computer is __________
mcqs.explanation: A flash drive often called as a pen drive enables easy transport of data from one computer to another. It comes in various shapes and sizes and may have different added features.

mcqs.question: What does USB stand for?
mcqs.explanation: USB stands for universal serial bus. A flash drive simply plugs in the USB port of a computer.

mcqs.question: A device similar to a flash drive ______________
mcqs.explanation: Memory card serves a similar purpose as that of a flash drive. It is in the shape of a card. Useful in electronic devices like Camera, music player, etc.

mcqs.question: What does RAID stand for?

options.a: a) Redundant array of independent disks
options.b: b) Redundant array of inexpensive disks
options.c: c) Redundant array of intermediate disks
options.d: d) Redundant array of  improper disks

mcqs.answer: a) Redundant array of independent disks
mcqs.explanation: RAID is Redundant array of independent disks. It is an array of disks which can store data bits.

mcqs.question: A set of hard disk drives with a controller mounted in a single box, forming a single large storage unit is ____________
mcqs.explanation: The answer is disk array. It is commonly known as RAID. As a secondary storage device, provides enhanced performance, enhanced storage capacity and reliability.

mcqs.question: The process in which a file is partitioned into smaller parts and different parts are stored in different disks is ____________
mcqs.explanation: Enhanced reliability is achieved by using techniques like mirroring and stripping in case of disk arrays. Stripping is the division of a large file into smaller parts and then storing them on different disks.

mcqs.question: Which of the following uses multiple hard disk platters mounted on a single central shift?
mcqs.explanation: Disk packs use a number of hard disk platters. Also, they are mounted on a single central shaft.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a magnetic disk?
mcqs.explanation: Flash drives are a type of memory storage devices. It is a relatively newer type of secondary storage device which enables easy transfer of data from one computer to another.

title: 8. Computer Fundamental MCQ on Input-Output Devices

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Input Devices”.

mcqs.question: These devices provide a means of communication between a computer and outer world.
mcqs.explanation: The I/O i.e. the input/output devices provide a means of communication between the computer and the outer world. They are often referred to as the peripheral devices sometimes.

mcqs.question: The I/O devices are sometimes called the peripheral devices because they surround the CPU and memory of the computer system.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. The input devices are used to enter data from the outside world into primary storage. The output devices supply results of processing from primary storage to users.

mcqs.question: Identify the blank space in the diagram.
mcqs.explanation: Firstly, the input is given to the input device, then the data in coded in internal form and is sent to the CPU. Further, the processed data is sent to the output device and the result is obtained.

mcqs.question: What does GUI stand for?
mcqs.explanation: GUI stands for a graphical user interface. Graphical user interface basically provides a set of graphical elements on the screen to the users. Commonly used for point-and-draw devices.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a point-and-draw device?
mcqs.explanation: All except the keypad are point-and-draw devices. They are used to rapidly point to and select a graphic icon or menu item from multiple options displayed on the GUI of a screen.

mcqs.question: A device used for video games, flight simulators, training simulators and for controlling industrial robots.
mcqs.explanation: Joystick is the device used for the same. It is a point-and-draw device. It has a click button, a stick, a ball, a socket as well as a light indicator.

mcqs.question: The unattended interactive information systems such as automatic teller machine or ATM is called as _________
mcqs.explanation: The term information kiosks are used for the same. Touch screens are used the most preferred human-computer interface used in information kiosks.

mcqs.question: Which are the input devices that enable direct data entry into a computer system from source documents?
mcqs.explanation: They are referred to as data scanning devices. They eliminate the need to key in text data into the computer. It demands the high quality of input documents.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of image scanner?
mcqs.explanation: Image scanners are the input devices that translate the paper documents into an electronic format for storage in a computer. Stored image can be altered or manipulated with image-processing software.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is capable of recognizing a pre-specified type of mark by pencil or pen?
mcqs.explanation: OMR stands for optical mark reader. These are very useful for grading tests with objective type questions or for any input data that is of choice or selection nature.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Output Devices”.

mcqs.question: Input Devices that use a special ink that contains magnetizable particles of iron oxide are ____
mcqs.explanation: MICR reads data on cheques and sorts them for distribution to other banks or for further processing. MICR stands for Magnetic-Ink-Character Recognition.

mcqs.question: MICR character set consists of only 2 digits 0 and 1.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false.  It consists of numerals from 0 to 9 and 4 special characters. It supports only 14 symbols.

mcqs.question: A printer that prints one line at a time and has a predefined set of characters is called _______
mcqs.explanation: The drum printers print one line at a time. They have a cylindrical drum with characters embossed on its surface in the form of circular bands.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a name of plotter as well as a printer?
mcqs.explanation: Drum is the name of a plotter as well as a printer. Drum printers have a predefined set of characters and print one line at a time. Drum plotters is an ideal device for architects and others who need to generate high-precision hard copy graphics output of widely varying sizes.

mcqs.question: Name the device that converts text information into spoken sentences.
mcqs.explanation: A speech synthesizer converts text information into spoken sentences. It is used for reading out text information to blind people. Allowing people to communicate effectively.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a part of a digitizer?
mcqs.explanation: A digitizer consists of a digitizing tablet, a stylus in the form of a cross-hair cursor. A digitizer is used in the areas of GIS.

mcqs.question: Which is the device used for converting maps, pictures and drawings into digital form for storage in computers?
mcqs.explanation: A digitizer serves the purpose given in the question. Digitizers are generally used in the area of Computer Aided Design by architects and engineers to design cars, buildings, etc.

mcqs.question: The process in which a file is partitioned into smaller parts and different parts are stored in different disks is called _________
mcqs.explanation: Enhanced reliability is achieved by using techniques like mirroring and stripping in case of disk arrays. Stripping is the division of a large file into smaller parts and then storing them on different disks.

mcqs.question: Which of the following Printers have a speed in the range of 40-300 characters per second?
mcqs.explanation: The inkjet printers are non-impact printers. Hence, they cannot produce multiple copies of a document in a single printing. Can be both monochrome and color.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a temporary output?
mcqs.explanation: There are only two types of outputs: hard copy and soft copy. Soft copy output is temporary and vanishes after use. Hard copy output is permanent in nature and can be kept in paper files, etc.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Digitizers”.

mcqs.question: Input Devices that use a special ink that is used for converting pictures, maps and drawings into digital format.
mcqs.explanation: The digitizer is used for digitizing pictures, maps and drawings into digital form for storage in computers. It is used in CAD by architects and engineers.

mcqs.question: GIS stands for Graphical Information System.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. GIS stands for Geographical Information System. Digitizers are used in the area of GIS for digitizing maps available in paper form.

mcqs.question: A digitizer converts __________ input into digital input.
mcqs.explanation: A digitizer converts analog signals to digital images. Due to this, it is compatible with both scanners and mice.

mcqs.question: Which of the following term is used when different forms of information like text, sound is converted to a binary code?
mcqs.explanation: Digitization is the term that is used.  It converts the input which is in the form of an image, sound or text into a binary format and further makes it easier for the computer to understand and process.

mcqs.question: Which of the following isn’t a phase of digitization?
mcqs.explanation: There is no phase called analog conversion. Discretization means the reading of an analog signal. Quantization is the rounding of samples to numbers.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a part of a digitizer?
mcqs.explanation: A digitizer consists of a digitizing tablet, a stylus in the form of a cross-hair cursor. A digitizer is used in the areas of Geographical Information Systems.

mcqs.question: The process of making digital information work for you is called ___________
mcqs.explanation: The process of making digitized data or information work for you is called digitalization. The conversion of analog signal to digital signal is called digitization. Digital signals are in the form of 0s and 1s.

mcqs.question: What is the full form of FSM?
mcqs.explanation: FSM is Field Service Management. FSM soft wares are used for making proper use of the digitized information. Therefore, they are basically responsible for digitalization.

mcqs.question: Which of the following Techniques are used to optimize field services?
mcqs.explanation: AI or Artificial Intelligence is optimizing the field services. It ensures that the fastest service is performed by the person in charge. Artificial intelligence is nothing but machine intelligence.

mcqs.question: Obtaining services from a rapidly evolving group of internet users __________
mcqs.explanation: Crowd sourcing is the appropriate term which is to be used. Though human collaboration, outsourcing and computation mean the same. Crowd Sourcing means collaboration of a group of internet users for the same purpose.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Speech Synthesizers”.

mcqs.question: What is the full form of TTS?
mcqs.explanation: TTS stands for Text to speech. It is a commonly used term with Speech Synthesis. Often called as text to speech synthesis.

mcqs.question: Text analysis is all about converting the input text into a ‘speakable’ form.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. This process has two phases: firstly the text goes through analysis and then the result is used to generate a speech signal.

mcqs.question: A concept that contains rhythm of speech, stress patterns and intonation is ________
mcqs.explanation: Prosody is the correct term. It contains three main parts: the rhythm of speech, the stress patterns and the intonation. Intonation is a term used for the rise and fall when a person speaks.

mcqs.question: Which of the following does not come under text analysis?
mcqs.explanation:
For TTS, the main concepts involved are :
01) Text Analysis
02) Phonetic Analysis
03) Prosodic Analysis
04) Speech Synthesis.

mcqs.question: What is the medium to convert text information into spoken sentences?
mcqs.explanation: A speech synthesizer converts text information into spoken sentences. It is used for reading out text information to blind people. This allows people to communicate effectively.

mcqs.question: Pitch and duration attachment comes under _____
mcqs.explanation: Pitch and duration attachment comes under Prosodic analysis. Other three terms are also used when we consider the text to speech conversion.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a speech synthesis method?
mcqs.explanation: Summative isn’t a Speech Synthesis method. Formant Synthesis is the oldest method. Concatenative is the cut-and-paste method. Whereas, Articulative tries to model the human speech production mechanisms.

mcqs.question: Speech Synthesis method based on the generation of periodic and non-periodic signals is ____________
mcqs.explanation: Formant synthesis is based on the same. It is based on the well known source-filter model whose idea is to generate periodic and non-periodic signals.

mcqs.question: What is the full form of SAMPA?

options.d: d) Speech Assessment Methods- Prosodic Alphabet

mcqs.explanation: IPA(International phonetic association) contains some symbols that are complicated and cannot be found in typewriters. SAMPA is an example of alphabets which are compatible with computers and based on ASCII characters.

mcqs.question: A speech synthesis model which tries to model the human speech production mechanisms is _________
mcqs.explanation: Articulative Synthesis tries to model the human speech production mechanisms. It is by far the most complicated speech synthesis method. Its implementation is difficult and therefore is not widely used.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “System Softwares”.

mcqs.question: The physical devices of a computer :
mcqs.explanation: Hardware refers to the physical devices of a computer system. Software refers to a collection of programs. A program is a sequence of instructions.

mcqs.question: Software Package is a group of programs that solve multiple problems.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false.  The software package is a group of programs that solve a specific problem or perform a specific type of job.

mcqs.question: ____________ refer to renewing or changing components like increasing the main memory, or hard disk capacities, or adding speakers, or modems, etc.
mcqs.explanation: Upgrades is the right term to be used. Upgrades are installed to renew or implement a new feature. Except for upgrades, hardware is normally one-time expense.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is designed to control the operations of a computer?
mcqs.explanation: Software is basically classified into two: System and application. System Software is designed to control the operations and extend the processing capability of a computer system.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not an example of system software?
mcqs.explanation: A system software is responsible for controlling the operations of a computer system. Word Processor is an application software since it is specific to its purpose.

mcqs.question: A person who designs the programs in a software package is called :
mcqs.explanation: The programs included in a system software package are called system programs. The programmers who design them and prepare them are called system programmers.

mcqs.question: ___________________ is designed to solve a specific problem or to do a specific task.
mcqs.explanation: An application software is specific to solving a specific problem. System software is designed for controlling the operations of a computer system.

mcqs.question: Assembler is used as a translator for?
mcqs.explanation: Assembler is used in case of low level languages. It is generally used to make the binary code into an understandable format. Interpreter is used with the high level languages similarly.

mcqs.question: What do you call a program in execution?
mcqs.explanation: Option Process is correct. A program is a set of instructions. A program in execution is called a process.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a process state?
mcqs.explanation: There is no blocked state in a process model. The different states are ready, running, executing,  waiting and terminated.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Application Softwares”.

mcqs.question: The software designed to perform a specific task:
mcqs.explanation: Software refers to a collection of programs. Software designed to do a specific task are referred to as the application software. Eg: Inventory management, banking, etc.

mcqs.question: Word processing software is a type of application software.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true.  Since, application software are designed to do a specific job, word processing is a type of application software used for the designing of text documents.

mcqs.question: Developing software __________ means a major commitment of time, money and resources.
mcqs.explanation: Developing software in-house means the same. It is easier to carry out changes in the software if it is developed in-house

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a way of acquiring software?
mcqs.explanation: Duplication is not a correct way of acquiring the software. All the other options are valid. Apart from these, another option could be development of a customized software.

mcqs.question: OSS stands for:
mcqs.explanation: OSS stands for open source software. OSS allows any user to download, view, modify and redistribute the software. Also, the user can fix bugs according to needs.

mcqs.question: Public domain software is usually:
mcqs.explanation: The public domain software is generally community supported. It is community supported as author does not support users directly.

mcqs.question: Set of programs which consist of full documentation.
mcqs.explanation: It is called a software package. A software is nothing but a collection of programs. A software package can solve a specific problem or perform a specific type of job.

mcqs.question: Interpreter is used as a translator for  __________
mcqs.explanation: It is generally used to make the code into an machine understandable format. Interpreter is used with the high level languages similarly. Assembler is used in case of low level languages.

mcqs.question: What do you call a specific instruction designed to do a task?
mcqs.explanation: A program is a set of instructions. A command is given to do a specific job. A program in execution is called a process.

mcqs.question: They normally interact with the system via user interface provided by the application software.
mcqs.explanation: Users interact with the system via user interface that is given by the application software. An application software is a set of instructions designed to serve a particular purpose.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Firmware & MiddleWare”.

mcqs.question: The software substituted for hardware and stored in ROM.
mcqs.explanation: Software refers to a collection of programs. Firm wares act as a link between the hardware and the system. It is stored in read only memory.

mcqs.question: Middleware has enabled the production of various types of smart machines having microprocessor chips with embedded software.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Firmware is designed for this purpose and not middleware. A middleware is for providing  abstraction in programming.

mcqs.question: A “glue” between client and server parts of application.
mcqs.explanation: A middleware acts as a glue between client and server parts of application. It provides programming abstraction which means hiding all the relevant details.

mcqs.question: MOM stands for?
mcqs.explanation: MOM is message-oriented middleware. It is basically responsible for sending and receiving messages across distributed systems.

mcqs.question: Storage of firmware is ___________
mcqs.explanation: Firmware is stored in ROM which is the read only memory. Firmware basically acts as a link between the hardware and the system.

mcqs.question: DNS stands for?
mcqs.explanation: DNS stands for Domain Name System. Domain name system is the way in which the internet domain names are traced and then translated into IP addresses.

mcqs.question: A software that lies between the OS and the applications running on it.
mcqs.explanation: It is called as middleware. Middleware enables the interaction between the Operating System and the applications running on it.

mcqs.question: A type of middleware that allows for between the built-in applications and the real-time OS?
mcqs.explanation: It is called the embedded middleware since it activates the communication link between the built-in applications and the real time operating system.

mcqs.question: What is the other name for object middleware?
mcqs.explanation: It is also called as object request broker. It gives the applications ability to send the objects and receive services through an object.

mcqs.question: The _______ calls certain procedures on remote systems and is used to perform synchronous or asynchronous interactions between systems.
mcqs.explanation: It is called the RPC or the Remote Procedure Call. The functioning is to call certain procedures on remote applications. This is generally utilized in a software application.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Open Source Software”.

mcqs.question: A software that can be freely accessed and modified.
mcqs.explanation: Software refers to a collection of programs. OSS stands for Open Source Software. It can be freely accessed, edited and modified according to our needs.

mcqs.question: Open Source Software can be used for commercial purpose.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. The definition of open source guarantees the use of open source software for commercial purposes. It is commercial but not proprietary.

mcqs.question: PNG is a _________
mcqs.explanation: PNG is an image format. It stands for portable network graphics. PNG supports palette based images.

mcqs.question: OSI stands for?
mcqs.explanation: OSI is open source initiative. It is a leading authority on OSS. OSS is a computer software distributed along with its source code.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not an open source software?
mcqs.explanation: MS-office is not open source software since its source code isn’t shared publicly. Others like Libre office, MySQL are open source softwares through which is distributed along with its source code.

mcqs.question: The users must agree to the _______ terms and agreements when they use an open source software.
mcqs.explanation: The users must agree to the license terms and agreement in order to access an open source software. There is a limitation of OSS that the users cannot modify the terms and conditions of any software.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a downside of OSS?
mcqs.explanation: An OSS is nothing but an open source software. It has restricted choices, i.e., there are fewer choices available for open source.  Also, speed of change is an important downside, since the software keeps on updating itself, we cannot ensure if it is compatible with other applications.

mcqs.question: An example of a web design OSS.
mcqs.explanation: Nvu is an example of an open source software for web designing. Others like KOffice, Open Office and AbiWorld are OSS examples for Office Automation.

mcqs.question: An image editor similar to Adobe Photoshop.
mcqs.explanation: GIMPshop is an image editor similar to adobe photoshop. Nvu is intended for those with no technical expertise.

mcqs.question: An OSS for communication purpose.
mcqs.explanation: Pidgin is used for Free Instant Messaging(IIM) client. Virtue mart and emart are for e-commerce purpose. Drupal is for content management.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers focuses on “Open Source Initiative”.

mcqs.question: A guideline for the OSS licenses other than the GPL.
mcqs.explanation: OSS is the open source software. In 1997, OSI or the open source initiative was founded and it developed the OSD (Open Source Definition). OSD is a guideline for OSS licenses other than the GPL.

mcqs.question: GPL of GNU says that every copy of a program governed by GPL license, even if modified, must be subject to GPL again.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. GPL is the general public license. In the 90s, GPL+Internet, many new open source projects started.

mcqs.question: Richard Stallman from MIT, established a special license, the ________ license.
mcqs.explanation: It was called the GNU license. It ensured that software is free and open to anyone. He was from MIT and his main motive was to develop a free alternative to Unix.

mcqs.question: In 1969 AT&T laboratories developed ______ which supported and worked on different hardware platforms.
mcqs.explanation: Unix was found in that year. It worked well on different hardware platforms. Commercial users had to pay a license fee.

mcqs.question: OSS stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: OSS stands for open source software. OSS allows any user to download, view, modify and redistribute the software. Also, the user can fix bugs according to needs.

mcqs.question: Public domain software is usually __________
mcqs.explanation: The public domain software is generally community supported. It is community supported as an author does not support users directly.

mcqs.question: Set of a program which consists of full documentation.
mcqs.explanation: It is called a software package. Software is nothing but a collection of programs. A software package can solve a specific problem or perform a specific type of job.

mcqs.question: Interpreter is used as a translator for?
mcqs.explanation: It is generally used to make the code into a machine understandable format. Interpreter is used with the high level languages similarly. Assembler is used in case of low level languages.

mcqs.question: What do you call a specific instruction designed to do a task?
mcqs.explanation: A program is a set of instructions. A command is given to do a specific job. A program in execution is called a process.

mcqs.question: They normally interact with the system via user interface provided by the application software.
mcqs.explanation: Users interact with the system via user interface that is given by the application software. Application software is a set of instructions designed to serve a particular purpose.

title: 10. Computer Fundamental MCQ on Planning the Computer Program

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Algorithms”.

mcqs.question: The word ____________comes from the name of a Persian mathematician Abu Ja’far Mohammed ibn-i Musa al Khowarizmi.
mcqs.explanation: The word algorithm comes from the name of a Persian mathematician Abu Ja’far Mohammed ibn-i Musa al Khowarizmi.

mcqs.question: In computer science, algorithm refers to a special method usable by a computer for the solution to a problem.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. This word algorithm refers to a special method usable by a computer for the solution to a problem. The statement of the problem specifies in general terms the desired input/output relationship.

mcqs.question: This characteristic often draws the line between what is feasible and what is impossible.
mcqs.explanation: Algorithms help us to understand scalability. Performance often draws the line between what is feasible and what is impossible.

mcqs.question: The time that depends on the input: an already sorted sequence that is easier to sort.
mcqs.explanation: The running time depends on the input: an already sorted sequence is easier to sort. The running time is given by the size of the input, since short sequences are easier to sort than the longer ones. Generally, we seek upper bounds on the running time, because it is reliable.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is incorrect? Algorithms can be represented:
mcqs.explanation:
Representation of algorithms:
-As programs
-As flowcharts
-As pseudo codes.

mcqs.question: When an algorithm is written in the form of a programming language, it becomes a _________
mcqs.explanation: An algorithm becomes a program when it is written in the form of a programming language. Thus, any program is an algorithm.

mcqs.question: Any algorithm is a program.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. An algorithm is represented in the form of a programming language is called a program. Any program is an algorithm but the reverse is not true.

mcqs.question: A system wherein items are added from one and removed from the other end.
mcqs.explanation: In a queue, the items are inserted from the rear end and deleted from the front end.

mcqs.question: Another name for 1-D arrays.
mcqs.explanation: Linear arrays are the 1-Dimensional arrays wherein only one row is present and the items are inserted.

mcqs.question: A data structure that follows the FIFO principle.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is Queue. A Queue follows the FIFO principle. FIFO stands for First In First Out.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Flowcharts”.

mcqs.question: The symbol denotes _______
mcqs.explanation: The symbol denotes a terminal. It is used for indication of start and stop nodes of a program.

mcqs.question: In computer science, algorithm refers to a pictorial representation of a flowchart.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. The correct statement would be: In computer science, flowchart refers to a pictorial representation of an algorithm.

mcqs.question: The process of drawing a flowchart for an algorithm is called __________
mcqs.explanation: It is called as flowcharting. A flowchart is nothing but a pictorial representation of an algorithm.

mcqs.question: Actual instructions in flowcharting are represented in __________
mcqs.explanation: The actual instructions are written in boxes. Boxes are connected by using arrows to indicate the exact flow of a flowchart and the order in which they are to be executed.

mcqs.question: The following box denotes?
mcqs.explanation: A diamond shape box denotes the decision making statements. It jumps to a truth value or a false value.

mcqs.question: A box that can represent two different conditions.
mcqs.explanation: A diamond shape box denotes either a truth value or a false value. It jumps onto two different statements following it via flow lines.

mcqs.question: There should be certain set standards on the amount of details that should be provided in a flowchart.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. There should be no set standards on the amount of details that should be provided in a flowchart.

mcqs.question: A detailed flowchart is called ______
mcqs.explanation: A detailed flowchart or a flowchart with more details is called as micro flowchart. It represents all the components of the algorithm that is followed.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not an advantage of a flowchart?
mcqs.explanation: Flowcharts provide a proper documentation. It also provides systematic debugging.

mcqs.question: A flowchart that outlines the main segments of a program.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is Macro Flowchart. A macro flowchart outlines the important components of a program. It therefore shows fewer details.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Flowcharting Rules”.

mcqs.question: A ______________ is diagram that depicts the flow of a program.
mcqs.explanation: A flowchart is a diagram that helps us determine the flow of the program. Other options are irrelevant.

mcqs.question: Terminals are represented by diagonals in a flowchart.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Terminals are represented by rounded rectangles. They indicate the starting or ending point in a flowchart.

mcqs.question: The operation represented by parallelograms.
mcqs.explanation: The input/output operations are represented by parallelograms. They generally are used to display messages during input and output part of a program.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a flowchart structure?
mcqs.explanation:
There are basically four flowcharting structures:
• Decision
• Repetition
• Case
• Sequence.

mcqs.question: The action performed by a ___________ structure must eventually cause the loop to terminate.
mcqs.explanation: The action performed by a repetition structure must eventually cause the loop to terminate. Otherwise, an infinite loop is created.

mcqs.question: The following symbol denotes:
mcqs.explanation: This symbol is that of a module. The terminal is denoted by a rounded rectangle. I/O operation by a parallelogram and process by a rectangle.

mcqs.question: What type of structure is this?
mcqs.explanation: This is a repetition structure. The action performed by a repetition structure must eventually cause the loop to terminate. Otherwise, an infinite loop is created.

mcqs.question: What type of a structure is this?
mcqs.explanation: This is a case structure. Certain cases are given along with a default case in the case structure.

mcqs.question: A _______ is a connector showing the relationship between the representative shapes.
mcqs.explanation: Arrows are the connectors that show the relationship between different shapes. They also show the flow of the program.

mcqs.question: The following box denotes?
mcqs.explanation: The answer is decision. Conditions are given in this box and then the result is checked accordingly if the condition is true or false.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Pseudo Code”.

mcqs.question: Keep the statement language ______________ while writing a pseudo code.
mcqs.explanation: The statement’s language should be independent. Other rules are to write only one statement per line and end multiline structures.

mcqs.question: Capitalize initial keyword – This is a rule while writing a pseudo code.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. It is an important rule to capitalize the initial keyword while writing a pseudo code.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a keyword?
mcqs.explanation: Start is not a Keyword. Other words like read, write, if, else, etc are keywords and convey a special meaning.

mcqs.question: ______________ is used to show hierarchy in a pseudo code.
mcqs.explanation:
Each design structure uses a particular indentation pattern.
Indentation should be considered in the following cases:
Sequence
Selection
Loop.

mcqs.question: The statement that tells the computer to get a value from an input device and store it in a memory location.
mcqs.explanation: The READ statement is used to take the input. READ being a keyword should be in capital letters.

mcqs.question: _____________ are identified by their addresses, we give them names (field names / variable names) using words.
mcqs.explanation: Memory locations are identified by their addresses, we give them names (field names/variable names) using words descriptive to us such as ctr as opposed to a location addresses such as 19087.

mcqs.question: ____________ begins with lower case letters.
mcqs.explanation: Variables begin with a lowercase. They contain no spaces. They also involve the consistent use of names.

mcqs.question: Another notation for exponentiation.
mcqs.explanation: Double asterisk sign is also used for exponentiation. The general notation is ^ sign.

mcqs.question: A symbol used for grouping.
mcqs.explanation: Parenthesis is used for grouping while working with fields. There are other symbols like *, +, -, **, etc.

mcqs.question: A statement used to close the IF block.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is ENDIF. It is used to close the IF block. ENDIF statement should be in line with the IF statement.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Structural Programming”.

mcqs.question: Programming based on stepwise refinement process.
mcqs.explanation: Structured programming is based on the stepwise refinement process-a method of problem decomposition common to all engineering disciplines and the physical, chemical, and biological sciences.

mcqs.question: Top-down approach is followed in structural programming.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. Structural programming follows the top – down approach. Each module is further divided into sub modules.

mcqs.question: A ________ is a directed graph that describes the flow of execution control of the program.
mcqs.explanation: A flowchart is a directed graph. It simply describes the flow of execution control of the program.

mcqs.question: A program should be ________
mcqs.explanation: It is natural to write a program as a sequence of program structures such as sequences, choices and loops.

mcqs.question:
The following is the syntax for: 
      ____(condition)
	action
mcqs.explanation: The if statement follows that syntax. If is a choice statement. Else is also a choice statement.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a loop statement?
mcqs.explanation:
WHILE is a loop statement.
Syntax : while(condition)
action.

mcqs.question: What is the correct syntax of for statement?
mcqs.explanation:
The correct syntax is : for(initialization;condition;update)
For is another loop statement.

mcqs.question: Semicolon is used after :
mcqs.explanation: Semicolon is used after function call otherwise it leads to compile-time errors. It shouldn’t be used after definitions. It should also not be used after loops.

mcqs.question: The number of values a function can return at a time?
mcqs.explanation:
A function can return only one value at a time.
Syntax : return (x,12);

mcqs.question: Which of the following isn’t a loop statement?
mcqs.explanation: The answer is elif. Elif isn’t a loop statement. It is a part of a choice statement.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Machine Languages”.

mcqs.question: The language made up of binary coded instructions.
mcqs.explanation: The language made up of binary coded instructions built into the hardware of a particular computer and used directly by the computer is machine language.

mcqs.question: Binary code comprises of digits from 0 to 9.
mcqs.explanation:
The statement is false. Binary as the word suggests contains only 2 digits : 0 and 1.
0 denotes false and 1 denotes a truth value.

mcqs.question: The ___________ contains the address of the next instruction to be executed.
mcqs.explanation: PC stands for program counter (It contains the address of the next instruction to be executed).

mcqs.question: The memory unit is made up of _____ bytes.
mcqs.explanation: The memory unit is made up of 4,096 bytes. Memory unit is responsible for the storage of data. It is an important entity in the computer system.

mcqs.question: A document that specifies how many times and with what data the program must be run in order to thoroughly test it.
mcqs.explanation: Test plan is the A document that specifies how many times and with what data the program must be run in order to thoroughly test it. It comes under testing.

mcqs.question: An approach that designs test cases by looking at the allowable data values.
mcqs.explanation: Data coverage is the term used.  It is responsible for designing the test cases.

mcqs.question: The formal grammar rules governing the construction of valid instruction.
mcqs.explanation: Syntax determines the grammatical rules in a code. Semantics give meaning to the instructions.

mcqs.question: A program that reads each of the instructions in mnemonic form and translates it into the machine-language equivalent.
mcqs.explanation: Assembler does this job. A language that uses mnemonic codes for the representation of machine-language instructions is called assembly language.

mcqs.question: An approach that designs test cases by looking at the allowable data values.
mcqs.explanation: Data coverage is an approach that designs test cases by looking at the allowable data values. Code coverage is an approach that designs test cases by looking at the code.

mcqs.question: The rules that give meaning to the instructions.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is semantics. They are the rules that give meaning to the instructions. The syntax is the formal rules that ensure validation of code.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Assembly Languages”.

mcqs.question: Each personal computer has a _________ that manages the computer’s arithmetical, logical and control activities.
mcqs.explanation: Microprocessor handles all these activities. Each family of processors has its own set of instructions for handling various operations like getting input from keyboard, displaying information on a screen and performing various other jobs.

mcqs.question: Assembly Language requires less memory and execution time.
mcqs.explanation:
The statement is true.
Advantages of using assembly language are:
• It requires less memory and execution time.
• It allows hardware-specific complex jobs in an easier way.
• It is suitable for time-critical jobs.

mcqs.question: The data size of a word is _________
mcqs.explanation:
The processor supports the following data sizes:
• Word: a 2-byte data item
• Double word: a 4-byte (32 bit) data item, etc.

mcqs.question: A direct reference of specific location.
mcqs.explanation:
There are two kinds of memory addresses:
• An absolute address – a direct reference of specific location.
• The segment address (or offset) – starting address of a memory segment with the offset value.

mcqs.question: A Borland Turbo Assembler.
mcqs.explanation: Tasm is the borland turbo assembler. Nasm is used with linux generally. Gas is the GNU assembler.

mcqs.question: The instructions that tell the assembler what to do.
mcqs.explanation: The executable instructions or simple instructions tell the processor what to do. Each instruction consists of an operation code (opcode). Each executable instruction generates one machine language instruction.

mcqs.question: The segment containing data values passed to functions and procedures within the program.
mcqs.explanation: The stack segment contains data values passed to functions and procedures within the program. The code segment defines an area in memory that stores the instruction codes.

mcqs.question: To speed up the processor operations, the processor includes some internal memory storage locations, called ___________
mcqs.explanation: The processor has some internal memory storage locations, known as registers. The registers stores data elements for processing without having to access memory.

mcqs.question: To locate the exact location of data in memory, we need the starting address of the segment, which is found in the DS register and an offset value. This offset value is also called?
mcqs.explanation: When operands are specified in memory addressing mode, direct access to main memory, usually to the data segment, is required. This way of addressing results in slower processing of data. To get the exact location of data in memory, we need segment start address, which is found in the DS register and an offset value. This offset value is called an effective address.

mcqs.question: Each byte of character is stored as its ASCII value in _______
mcqs.explanation: Assembly language deals with hexadecimal values only. Each decimal value is automatically converted to its 16-bit binary equivalent and stored as a hexadecimal number.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “High Level Languages”.

mcqs.question: Prolog comes under ___________
mcqs.explanation: Prolog stands for Programming in Logic. The options mentioned are the four categories of programming. Prolog is a type of logic programming.

mcqs.question: Java is procedural programming.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Java is a type of object oriented programming language. It involves solving real-life problems as well.

mcqs.question: A  program that can execute high-level language programs.
mcqs.explanation: Interpreter is a program that can execute high-level language programs “directly,” without first being translated into machine language.

mcqs.question: Executables might be called ________
mcqs.explanation: The executables are sometimes called native code. HLL are translated to Machine language called the native code.

mcqs.question: Source program is compiled to an intermediate form called ___________
mcqs.explanation: The Source program is compiled to an intermediate form called byte code. For each supported platform, write a “virtual machine” emulator that reads byte code and emulates its execution.

mcqs.question: _______________ is the assembly language for an imaginary architecture.
mcqs.explanation: Source program is compiled to an intermediate form – byte code. Byte code is the assembly language for an imaginary architecture.

mcqs.question: JIT stands for?
mcqs.explanation: JIT stands for Just in time. JVMs actually compile each bytecode instruction to native code the first time it is used.

mcqs.question: JVM stands for?
mcqs.explanation: JVM stands for Java Virtual Machine. Other related terms are JRE which is java runtime environment and JDK which is java development kit.

mcqs.question: A language supported by MS. Net platform.
mcqs.explanation: C# is supported by MS. Net platform. JAVA was originally designed for web purposes.

mcqs.question: Which of the following isn’t a characteristic of High level languages?
mcqs.explanation: HLL isn’t in machine language. It is converted to machine language for further processing.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “FORTRAN Basics”.

mcqs.question: Which is interpreted language?
mcqs.explanation: MATLAB is an interpreted language. All the other languages are compiled languages. In the case of Interpreted language, the translation to machine-language is performed incrementally at run-time.

mcqs.question: In compiled language, the translation to machine-language is performed incrementally at run-time.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. The translation is performed once, then executable file is run as frequently as needed without further translation.

mcqs.question: The first widely-used high level language developed in 1957.
mcqs.explanation: Fortran which stands for Formula Translation was the first widely-used high level language. It was developed by IBM for scientific applications. The program was entered as punch cards.

mcqs.question: A text file that contains our program is called as __________
mcqs.explanation: A file that contains the code or the main program is called as the source file. Source code must be processed by a compiler to create an executable file.

mcqs.question: First statement in a fortran code is _________
mcqs.explanation:
It is the program statement. program statement is followed by the program name.
Syntax : program xyz

mcqs.question: A Fortran is not ___________
mcqs.explanation: Fortran is not a case sensitive language. For e.g. PROGRAM xyz also works. Also, multiple consecutive blank spaces are ignored.

mcqs.question: The delimiter in a FORTRAN code.
mcqs.explanation: Delimiter separates the tokens we use in our code. In a FORTRAN code, single blank space serves as a delimiter. Though, multiple blank spaces are ignored.

mcqs.question: A program that reads the source code and converts it to a form usable by the computer.
mcqs.explanation: A compiler does this task. Internally, 3 steps are performed: preprocessing, checking and compiling.  Further, assembler and linker do the work.

mcqs.question: A valid variable declaration in FORTRAN is __________
mcqs.explanation:
A variable declaration has the following syntax:
Data type :: variable name

mcqs.question: In FORTRAN, the declarations of variables can be modified using the _____ parameter.
mcqs.explanation: Kind can be used for this purpose.  It can often be used for the precision of reals. If you want to change the precision, it can easily be done using one line of code.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “COBOL Basics”.

mcqs.question: COBOL stands for _________
mcqs.explanation: COBOL stands for Common Business Oriented Language. It is designed for business purpose. It is fast and relatively simple to learn.

mcqs.question: COBOL is a language that keeps evolving.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. COBOL has billions of lines of existing code with more added each year. It thus keeps updating itself.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a part of the program division in COBOL?
mcqs.explanation: COBOL has 4 basic parts in the division section: Identification, Environment, data and procedure.  Each program is organized like a book.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a part of the Identification division?
mcqs.explanation:
The order of identification division is:
Paragraphs
Entries
Clauses.

mcqs.question: D in COBOL stands for _________
mcqs.explanation: It stands for debugging lines. Compiler fills in with the sequence numbers.  There are certain coding rules that must be followed in COBOL.

mcqs.question: Comment in COBOL is denoted by  ________
mcqs.explanation: Comment is denoted by asterisk. (*) It denotes the comment line. Hyphen – denotes continuation.

mcqs.question: The data division is used to ________
mcqs.explanation: The data division is used to declare and create variables and constant fields. There are 3 basic data types in COBOL.

mcqs.question: Which is not a data type in COBOL?
mcqs.explanation: There is no data type called as float in COBOL. It has only 3 basic data types: numeric, alphabetic and alphanumeric. Variables are created in the data division.

mcqs.question: What does S denote in a picture clause?
mcqs.explanation: It denotes a sign in a picture clause. Picture clause values usually use 9, X, V, S, A.

mcqs.question: _____________ denotes the format in which data is stored in memory.
mcqs.explanation: Usage denotes the format in which data is stored in the memory. Normally the phrase usage is omitted in COBOL.

title: 12. Computer Fundamental MCQ on System Implementation and Operation

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Testing”.

mcqs.question: Another name for white-box testing is ___________
mcqs.explanation: Sometimes it is called the glass box testing. It is a type of testing in which the internal structure of any application is tested and examined.

mcqs.question: Test cases ensure that all the statements are executed atleast once.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. Test cases are written to check if all the statements are executed at least once. It also checks the logicality of the code.

mcqs.question: Which of the following divides the input domain into classes containing data?
mcqs.explanation: Equivalent partitioning divides the input domain into classes containing data. They basically exercise on a specific functionality of a software.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a common testing conducted by the developers?
mcqs.explanation: Unit testing is commonly performed by the developers. It is difficult to perform testing at any time during its cycle. An early start decreases the time and cost.

mcqs.question: SDLC stands for ________
mcqs.explanation: It stands for Software development life cycle. In SDLC, the testing can be started from the software gathering requirement phase. And can be carried over till the deployment phase.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a myth in testing?

options.b: b) Any user can test software
options.c: c) Missed defects are not due to testers
options.d: d) Complete testing is not possible

mcqs.answer: b) Any user can test software
mcqs.explanation: Any user can test software is a myth. Anyone cannot test the software. A person who has no knowledge cannot test the software.

mcqs.question: A process to determine how the actual testing is done _______
mcqs.explanation: Audit is the systematic process which can determine how the actual process of testing is done. Audit is generally done with a team.

mcqs.question: Gathering formal or informal technical feedback is called _________
mcqs.explanation: The term used is inspection. Inspection helps in getting a formal or an informal feedback of a particular product. The errors can be easily examined.

mcqs.question: Which is not involved in debugging?
mcqs.explanation: Testing is a different process and is different from debugging. Debugging involves identifying, isolating and fixation of the problems or errors.

mcqs.question: A standard for unit testing.
mcqs.explanation: IEEE 1008 is a standard defined for unit testing. Rest all the other standards mentioned are invalid. There are certain standards defined for Quality assurance.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Debugging”.

mcqs.question: Examination of the program step by step is called ______________
mcqs.explanation: Debuggers perform the task of step by step examination of the code which is called stepping. They also perform tracing.

mcqs.question: The examination of changing values of variables is called stepping.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. It is called tracing. In tracing, the variables are examined wherever it value is changing.

mcqs.question: A freeware GNU Debugger is __________
mcqs.explanation: GDB is a free GNU debugger which runs on most of the Unix-like platforms. It works for multiple programming languages. GNU is free software.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is written for getting help in GDB?
mcqs.explanation: In this h stands for help. h or help both commands can be used. Help lists all the commands.

mcqs.question: h command gives ___________

options.a: a) A list of all the commands starting from h
options.c: c) Displays a short description of the command

mcqs.answer: c) Displays a short description of the command
mcqs.explanation: h command displays a short description of the command. If simply help is written it gives a list of all the commands.

mcqs.question: ____________ creates an inferior process that runs your program.
mcqs.explanation: run or r command creates an inferior process that runs your program. If there are no errors the program will finish and results will be displayed accordingly.

mcqs.question: Which of the following does not affects the execution of the program?
mcqs.explanation:
Execution is affected by :
-> arguments
-> environment
-> Working directory
-> standard I/O.

mcqs.question: ‘set args ‘ without arguments can ___________
mcqs.explanation:
set args command can remove all the arguments.
Syntax: set args arg1 arg2 …
If the arguments are not given it deletes all the arguments.

mcqs.question: Which is not involved in debugging?
mcqs.explanation: Testing is a different process and is different from debugging. Debugging involves identifying, isolating and fixation of the problems or errors.

mcqs.question: run >  outfile command is used to _________

options.a: a) direct output to the file outfile
options.b: b) jump to a file outfile

mcqs.answer: a) direct output to the file outfile
mcqs.explanation: run > outfile directs the output to the file outfile. Certain commands like ‘ cd dir ‘ are used to change the working directory.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Documentation”.

mcqs.question: STD stands for ____________
mcqs.explanation: STD which stands for Software test documents is a part of Software Process Documentation. Several other terms used in documentation are SDP, SRS, etc.

mcqs.question: The SRS describes what the system should do with words and figures.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. SRS stands for Software Requirements Specifications. It describes what the system should do in theoretical terms.

mcqs.question: _______  is part of user documentation.
mcqs.explanation: Installation guide is a part of user documentation. It also comprises of user manual, installation guide, Wiki and the online documentation and help.

mcqs.question: The process of maintaining a record of project development and maintenance.
mcqs.explanation: It is called as process documentation only. It contains the plans, schedules, etc. It also contains the gantt chart.

mcqs.question: This describes the objectives of the project and sets out constraints such as schedule, cost, and risks.
mcqs.explanation: SDP is correct because it defines the project’s objectives, scope, constraints, and planning aspects such as risks and schedules. SRS, on the other hand, focuses on what the system should do by specifying functional and non-functional requirements. Since the question emphasizes objectives and constraints rather than system behavior, SDP is the appropriate choice.

mcqs.question: ____________ provide additional supporting information like hardware configuration and database details.
mcqs.explanation: Appendices provide additional supporting information. It can include hardware and database descriptions. Hardware requirements include minimal and optimal configurations of a system.

mcqs.question: Which of the following should describe the technical terms used in the document?
mcqs.explanation: Glossary should describe the technical terms used in the document. In this, the writer shouldn’t make assumptions about the experience and expertise of the reader.

mcqs.question: The services provided for the user are described in which section?
mcqs.explanation: The services provided by the software for the user are described in this section. The non-functional requirements should also be described in this section.

mcqs.question: ______________ architecture provides a high-level overview of the anticipated system architecture.
mcqs.explanation: System architecture shows the description and distribution functions across system modules. Architectural components that are reused should be highlighted.

mcqs.question: The graphical models showing the relationships between the system and its environment.
mcqs.explanation: System models describe the relationships between various entities. It comprises of various models like data flow, use case, semantic data models etc.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “System Evaluation & Maintenance”.

mcqs.question: Maintenance and review add to the useful life of the system but can consume large amounts of __________
mcqs.explanation: They consume a large amount of resources. They can benefit from the methods and project management techniques though which are applied to the systems development.

mcqs.question: File and database contains the frequency component.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Frequency is a part of output design. File design contains capabilities and organization.

mcqs.question: This is not a part of the signing on the procedure.
mcqs.explanation: Signing on is a part of special system design considerations. It does not involve a step of execution. It involves identification, verification and authorization.

mcqs.question: A __________ is a noted set of activities that are executed on the software in order to confirm its behavior to certain set of inputs.
