mcqs.explanation: A client program obtains a remote reference to one or more remote objects on a server.  It then invokes methods on them.

mcqs.question: The ___________ layer, which provides the interface that client and server application objects use to interact with each other.
mcqs.explanation: The stub or skeleton layer provides the interface that client and server application objects use for interaction with each other.

mcqs.question: A layer which is the binary data protocol layer.
mcqs.explanation: The transport protocol layer is the binary data protocol that sends remote object requests over the wire. A client is any remote application that communicates with these server objects.

mcqs.question: A middleware layer between the stub skeleton and transport.
mcqs.explanation: The remote reference layer is the middleware between the stub/skeleton layer and underlying transport protocol.

mcqs.question: An object acting as a gateway for the client side.
mcqs.explanation: The stub is an object that acts as a gateway for the client side. The outgoing requests are passed through the stub.

mcqs.question: A gateway for the server side object.
mcqs.explanation: The skeleton is an object, acts as a gateway for the server side object. All the incoming requests are routed through it.

mcqs.question: RMI uses stub and skeleton for communication with the ________ object.
mcqs.explanation: RMI uses stub and skeleton object for communication with the remote object. A remote object is an object whose method can be invoked from another JVM.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Cloud Computing”.

mcqs.question: ________________ is a paradigm of distributed computing to provide the customers on-demand, utility based computing service.
mcqs.explanation: Cloud computing is a paradigm of distributed computing to provide the customers with on-demand, utility based computing services.  Cloud users can provide more reliable, available and updated services to their clients in turn.

mcqs.question: Cloud providers provide cloud services to the cloud users.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. There are three types of users often called as cloud stakeholders.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a cloud stakeholder?
mcqs.explanation: There are three types of stakeholders cloud providers, cloud users and the end users.

mcqs.question: These cloud services are of the form of utility computing i.e. the _________ uses these services pay-as-you-go model.
mcqs.explanation: The cloud users use these services pay-as-you-go model. The cloud users develop their product using these services and deliver the product to the end users.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a type of cloud?
mcqs.explanation: There is no protected cloud. There are three types of cloud-private, public and hybrid.

mcqs.question: In this type of cloud, an organization rents cloud services from cloud providers on-demand basis.
mcqs.explanation: This happens in public cloud. Services are provided to the users using utility computing model.

mcqs.question: In this type of cloud, the cloud is composed of multiple internal or external cloud.
mcqs.explanation: The hybrid cloud is composed of multiple internal or external clouds. This is the scenario when an organization moves to public cloud computing domain from its internal private cloud.

mcqs.question: _____________ enables the migration of the virtual image from one physical machine to another.
mcqs.explanation: Virtualization enables the migration of the virtual image from one physical machine to another. This feature is useful for cloud as by data locality lots of optimization is possible.

mcqs.question: Most of the cloud architectures are built on this type of architecture.
mcqs.explanation: Most of the cloud architectures are built on Grid architecture. Grid is a type of distributed computing architecture where organizations owning data centers collaborate with each other to have common benefits.

mcqs.question: Saas stands for?
mcqs.explanation: SAAS is Software as a service. It delivers a single application through the web browser to thousands of customers using a multitenant architecture.

links.context: This set of Basic Computer Fundamentals Questions and Answers focuses on “Types of Computers”.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a type of computer on the basis of operation?
mcqs.explanation:
There are three types of computers basically on the basis of operation:
Analog, Digital and Hybrid.

mcqs.question: Remote computers work on continuous range of values.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Analog Computer is a computing device that works on continuous range of values. The results that are given by the analog computers will mostly be approximate since they deal with quantities that keep on varying.

mcqs.question: A computer that operates on digital data.
mcqs.explanation: The digital computer uses binary number system in which there are only two digits 0 and 1. Each one is called a bit.

mcqs.question: This type of computer is mostly used for automatic operations.
mcqs.explanation: Hybrid computer is mostly used with automatic operations of complicated physical processes and the machines.

mcqs.question: ______________ are used for solving complex application such as Global Weather Forecasting.
mcqs.explanation: Super computers are used with complex applications like Global Weather Forecasting, Creating graphic images, engineering design and testing, space exploration, etc.

mcqs.question: The invention of _______________ gave birth to the much cheaper micro computers.
mcqs.explanation: The invention of microprocessor (also called as single chip CPU) gave birth to the much cheaper microcomputers.

mcqs.question: They can operate on batteries and hence are very popular with travelers.
mcqs.explanation: Laptops can operate on batteries and hence are very popular with travelers. The screen folds down onto the keyboard when not in use.

mcqs.question: PDA stands for?
mcqs.explanation: PDAs are also called as Handheld. They are small and can be carried anywhere.

mcqs.question: PDAs are also called?
mcqs.explanation: PDAs are also called as Personal Digital Assistants. They are small and can be carried anywhere.

mcqs.question: ______computers are lower to mainframe computers in terms of speed and storage capacity.
mcqs.explanation:
The answer is a. Mini computers are compared to mainframe computers in terms of:
1. speed and, 2. storage capacity.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Internet of Things”.

mcqs.question: A network of physical objects or things embedded with electronics or softwares.
mcqs.explanation: IoT is a network of physical objects or things embedded with electronics or softwares. Iot allows objects to be controlled remotely across existing network.

mcqs.question: RFID is a part of IoT.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. RFID is Radio frequency identification. Radio frequency identification is a part of IoT.

mcqs.question: RFID stands for?
mcqs.explanation: Earlier, RFID or Radio frequency identification was a prerequisite for Internet of Things.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not involved in working of IoT?
mcqs.explanation: IoT works from RFID to Sensor, to Smart tech and then to Nano tech.

mcqs.question: Making the smaller and smaller things have the ability to connect and interact.
mcqs.explanation: Nano Tech is the term used when smaller things are made to interact and communicate. It is involved in the working of Iot also.

mcqs.question: Wi-Fi stands for?
mcqs.explanation: Wi-Fi stands for Wireless Fidelity. It is widely used in both outdoor and indoor environments.

mcqs.question: Diagnostics service for Cars.
mcqs.explanation: Autobot is a diagnostics service for cars. This service is integrated with several web services.

mcqs.question: The father of ioT.
mcqs.explanation: Kevin Ashton is the father of IoT. He believed IoT could turn the world into data.

mcqs.question: Collect->Communicate->__________->Act
mcqs.explanation:
The correct option is analyze. This shows the lifecycle of IoT.
Collect->Communicate->Analyze->Act.

mcqs.question: Several instructions execution simultaneously in?
mcqs.explanation: In parallel processing, the several instructions are executed simultaneously. Parallel processing system provides the concurrent data processing to increase the execution time.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Artificial Intelligence”.

mcqs.question: The technology that has the ability to interact with the world.
mcqs.explanation: AI which is artificial intelligence is the ability to interact with the world. It is the ability to model the world and to learn and adapt.

mcqs.question: The goal of AI is to build systems that exhibit intelligent behavior.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. There are 2 main goals in AI:  to exhibit intelligent behavior and understand intelligence in order to model it.

mcqs.question: The first neural network computer.
mcqs.explanation: SNARC was the first neural network computer. it was built by Minsky and Edmonds in 1956.

mcqs.question: A hardware based system that has autonomy, social ability and reactivity.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is Autonomous Agent. Autonomous agent has autonomy i.e. ability to operate without the direct intervention of humans or others.

mcqs.question: A particular system that contains intelligent agents.
mcqs.explanation: It is called an AI system. A particular system consisting of intelligent agents like computers or robots that cooperate to find the solution to a problem.

mcqs.question: A methodology used to develop behavior-based autonomous agents.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is behavior engineering. Autonomous agent implements autonomy, social ability and reactivity.

mcqs.question: An international research effort to promote autonomous robots.
mcqs.explanation: RoboCup is designed to promote autonomous robots. It is based on multi agent collaboration.

mcqs.question: A type of non-monotonic reasoning.
mcqs.explanation: Default reasoning is a type of non-monotonic reasoning. Default logic is a non-monotonic logic proposed by Raymond Reiter to formalize reasoning with default assumptions.

mcqs.question: The performance of an agent can be improved based on this.
mcqs.explanation: An AI system is designed to learn and improve. The same is implemented on its agents.

mcqs.question: Face recognition system is based on _____________
mcqs.explanation: The answer is applied AI. It is based on applied artificial intelligence. It is an approach to develop commercially smart systems.

title: 19. Computer Fundamental MCQ on Information Technology

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Network Security”.

mcqs.question: The field that covers a variety of computer networks, both public and private, that are used in everyday jobs.
mcqs.explanation: Network security covers a variety of computer networks, both private and public. Everyday jobs like conducting transactions and communications among business and government agencies etc.

mcqs.question: Network Security provides authentication and access control for resources.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. AFS is an example. It helps us protect vital information.

mcqs.question: Which is not an objective of network security?
mcqs.explanation: The Identification, Authentication and Access control are the objectives of network security. There is no such thing called lock.

mcqs.question: Which of these is a part of network identification?
mcqs.explanation: The answer is UserID. UserID is a part of identification. UserID can be a combination of username, user student number etc.

mcqs.question: The process of verifying the identity of a user.
mcqs.explanation: It is called an authentication. It is typically based on passwords, smart card, fingerprint, etc.

mcqs.question: A concern of authentication that deals with user rights.
mcqs.explanation: Functional authorization is concerned with individual user rights. Authorization is the function of specifying access rights to resources related to information security.

mcqs.question: CHAP stands for?
mcqs.explanation: CHAP stands for Challenge Handshake authentication protocol. Features of CHAP: plaintext, memorized token. Protocol uses Telnet, HTTP.

mcqs.question: Security features that control that can access resources in the OS.
mcqs.explanation: Access control refers to the security features. Applications call access control to provide resources.

mcqs.question: An algorithm in encryption is called _____________
mcqs.explanation: An algorithm used in encryption is referred to as a cipher. cipher is an algorithm for performing encryption or decryption

mcqs.question: The information that gets transformed in encryption is ____________
mcqs.explanation: The text that gets transformed is called plain text. The algorithm used is called cipher.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Network Security and Encryption”.

mcqs.question: WTLS stands for?
mcqs.explanation: WTLS is Wireless Transport Security Layer. It provides security between the mobile device and the WAP gateway to internet.

mcqs.question: The protocol designed to make the security of wireless LAN as good as that of wired LAN.
mcqs.explanation: WEP stands for Wired Equivalent Privacy. WEP has been broken already in 2001. WEP protocol designed to make the security of wireless LAN as good as that of wired LAN.

mcqs.question: A person who enjoys learning details about computers and how to enhance their capabilities.
mcqs.explanation: The person is called hacker. A person who enjoys learning the details of computer systems and how to stretch their capabilities is called hacker.

mcqs.question: A program created by Farmer and Venema for auditing capability.
mcqs.explanation: SATAN is the Security analysis tool for auditing networks. It is created by farmer and venema.

mcqs.question: A small program that changes the way a computer operates.
mcqs.explanation: The program is called virus. It alters the way that the computer operates. It often does damages like deleting and corrupting files and data.

mcqs.question: A program that copies itself.
mcqs.explanation: A worm copies itself from one system to another over a network without the assistance of human.

mcqs.question: An attack in which the site is not capable of answering valid request.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is Denial of service. In case of denial of service attacks, a computer site is bombarded with a lot of messages.

mcqs.question: Creating a computer or paper audit that can help detect wrong doings.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is auditing. It is done to keep an eye on wrong doings. Auditing can be used as a deterrent.

mcqs.question: An indirect form of surveillance.
mcqs.explanation: Honey pot is an indirect form of surveillance. Network personnel create a trap, watching for unscrupulous acts.

mcqs.question: A malicious code hidden inside a seemingly harmless piece of code.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is Trojan horse. Trojan horse is a code that is present in a program that appears harmless.

mcqs.question: Attack in which a user creates a packet that appears to be something else.
mcqs.explanation: The attack is a spoofing attack. It is when a user creates a packet that appears to be something else or from someone else.

mcqs.question: A technique in which a program attacks a network by exploiting IP broadcast addressing operations.
mcqs.explanation: Smurfing is a technique in which a program attacks a network by exploiting IP broadcast addressing operations.

mcqs.question: An attack in which the user receives unwanted amount of e-mails.
mcqs.explanation: In the case of denial of e-mail bombing, a user sends an excessive amount of unwanted e-mail to someone.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Encryption and Viruses”.

mcqs.question: A cipher in which the order is not preserved.
mcqs.explanation: In transposition-based cipher, the order of the plain text is not preserved. They can be very simple to identify.

mcqs.question: Plain text is the data after encryption is performed.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Cipher is the algorithm used in encryption.  Ciphertext is the data after encryption is performed.

mcqs.question: A unique piece of information that is used in encryption.
mcqs.explanation: The key is the unique piece of information.  It is used to create the cipher text and decrypt it back.

mcqs.question: Study of creating and using encryption and decryption techniques.
mcqs.explanation: It is called as cryptography. It is the study of creating and using the encryption techniques.

mcqs.question: The process of transforming plain text into unreadable text.
mcqs.explanation: Encryption is the process of transforming readable text i.e. plain text to make it unreadable to anyone except those possessing special knowledge, usually referred to as a key.

mcqs.question: An algorithm used in encryption is referred to as cipher.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. Cipher is the algorithm used in encryption. Encryption is making readable text as unreadable to keep it secured.

mcqs.question: A process of making the encrypted text readable again.
mcqs.explanation: The reverse process is called decryption. It is the process of making the information readable again.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Cryptography”.

mcqs.question: These ciphers replace a character or characters with a different character or characters, based on some key.
mcqs.explanation: In mono alphabetic substitution-based cipher, a character is replaced with some other character or multiple characters, based on some key.

mcqs.question: Encryption is the study of creating and using decryption techniques.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Cryptography is the study of creating and using encryption and decryption techniques.

mcqs.question: A type of cipher that uses multiple alphabetic strings.
mcqs.explanation: These ciphers are similar to that of mono alphabetic ciphers. Multiple strings are used to encode the plain text.

mcqs.question: An encryption technique with 2 keys is ______________
mcqs.explanation: It is called as public key cryptography. It has 2 keys: a private key and a public key.

mcqs.question: In public key cryptography, a key that decrypts the message.
mcqs.explanation: Public key cryptography has 2 keys. They are private key and a public key. The public key encrypts the message. The private key decrypts the message.

mcqs.question: DES stands for?
mcqs.explanation: DES stands for Data Encryption Standard. It was created in 1977 and went into operation from 1990s.

mcqs.question: Under DES, the data encryption standard took a 64-bit block of data and subjected it to ______ levels of encryption.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is 16. It was subjected to 16 levels of encryption. DES is the data encryption standard.

mcqs.question: Triple-DES has ______ keys.
mcqs.explanation: There are 2 keys in triple DES as well. The private and the public key. It can also have 3 unique keys.

mcqs.question: Encryption standard that is selected by the US government to replace DES.
mcqs.explanation: AES is Advanced Encryption Standard. It was selected by the US government. It is used to replace DES.

mcqs.question: An electronic document that establishes your credentials when you are performing transactions.
mcqs.explanation: Digital certificate is an electronic document that is responsible for secure internet transactions.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals MCQs focuses on “Augmented Reality”.

mcqs.question: A field of technology that deals with a combination of real world and the data generated from computer.
mcqs.explanation: AR that is Augmented Reality is a field of technology that deals with a combination of real world and the data generated from computer.

mcqs.question: AR is interactive in real-time.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. Augmented Reality is the field of computer research that deals with the combination of real-world and computer generated data.

mcqs.question: Technologies that completely involve a user inside a synthetic environment.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is VR or Virtual Reality. VR technologies are known for immersing a user inside a synthetic environment. While immersed, the user cannot see the real world around him.

mcqs.question: Technologies that allow the user to see the real world, with virtual objects composited in the real world.
mcqs.explanation: Augmented Reality (AR) allows a user to see real world, with virtual objects superimposed or composited with the real world.

mcqs.question: A ______________________ is a display device, worn on head as a part of helmet that has a small display optic.
mcqs.explanation: HMD is the head-mounted display, worn on head as a part of helmet that has a small display optic. HTC Vive, Samsung GearVR are examples of HMDs available today.

mcqs.question: Wearable computing device in the form of computerized eyeglasses.
mcqs.explanation: Smart glasses are also called as optical head mounted displays. (OHMD), it has the capability of reflecting projected images as well as allowing users to see through it.

mcqs.question: A tracking based on geo-location information.
mcqs.explanation: Location based tracking is based on geo-location information obtained from device’s location sensors. (Longitude, latitude, altitude etc).

mcqs.question: SLAM stands for?
mcqs.explanation: SLAM is abbreviated for Simultaneous localization and mapping. It is a technique used by robots and autonomous vehicles to build a map within the unknown environment.

mcqs.question: A technique that enables light field which is generally the product of a light source scattered off objects.
mcqs.explanation: Holography enables a light field. It is to be recorded and later reconstructed when the original light field is no longer present.

mcqs.question: A _______ can be recorded using a normal light source.
mcqs.explanation: A photograph can be captured using a normal light source. A laser is required to record a hologram.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Waterfall Model”.

mcqs.question: A model that is the demo implementation of the system.
mcqs.explanation: Prototype is the demo implementation so that the customer gets a brief idea of his product. It is generally used when the customer requirements are not clear.

mcqs.question: Maintenance is the final phase in waterfall model.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. This is the phase in which the completed software product is handed over to the client.

mcqs.question: A stage in which individual components are integrated and ensured that they are error-free to meet customer requirements.
mcqs.explanation: Hardware and software components are tested individually. Testing stage in which individual components are integrated and ensured that they are error-free to meet customer requirements.

mcqs.question: ___________ is a step in which design is translated into machine-readable form.
mcqs.explanation: Coding is the step in which design in translated into machine-readable form. If design is efficient, coding can be done effectively.

mcqs.question: The customer requirements are broken down into logical modules for ease of _______________
mcqs.explanation: The requirements are broken down for ease of implementation. Hardware and software requirements are identified and designed accordingly.

mcqs.question: What do you call a technical person who is capable of understanding the basic requirements?
mcqs.explanation: The person is called an analyst. An analyst is a software engineering who is responsible for requirements gathering.

mcqs.question: A step in waterfall model that involves a meeting with the customer to understand the requirements.
mcqs.explanation: A waterfall model involves requirement gathering as its first step. This is the most important phase. It is important to understand the customer requirements.

mcqs.question: Methodology in which project management processes were step-by step.
mcqs.explanation: Waterfall model is based on step-by step completion of the project. Every step is done individually.

mcqs.question: An individual who plans and directs the work.
mcqs.explanation: Project Manager is the one who plans and designs the project. Team leader is the one who provides guidance, instruction, direction and leadership to a group of individuals.

mcqs.question: A planned program if work that requires a definitive amount of time, effort and planning to complete.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is Project. A project is a program which is something which is planned and needs effort and time to complete.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Software Testing”.

mcqs.question: A set of activities that ensure that software correctly implements a specific function.
mcqs.explanation: Verification ensures that software correctly implements a specific function. It is a static practice of verifying documents.

mcqs.question: Validation is computer based.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is true. Validation is a computer based process. It uses methods like black box testing, gray box testing, etc.

mcqs.question: ___________ is done in the development phase by the debuggers.
mcqs.explanation: Coding is done by the developers. In debugging, the developer fixes the bug in the development phase. Testing is conducted by the testers.

mcqs.question: Locating or identifying the bugs is known as ___________
mcqs.explanation: Testing is conducted by the testers. They locate or identify the bugs. In debugging developer fixes the bug. Coding is done by the developers.

mcqs.question: Which defines the role of software?
mcqs.explanation: The answer is system engineering. System engineering defines the role of software.

mcqs.question: What do you call testing individual components?
mcqs.explanation: The testing strategy is called unit testing. It ensures a function properly works as a unit.

mcqs.question: A testing strategy that test the application as a whole.
mcqs.explanation: Validation testing tests the application as a whole against the user requirements. In system testing, it tests the application in the context of an entire system.

mcqs.question: A testing strategy that tests the application in the context of an entire system.
mcqs.explanation: In system testing, it tests the application in the context of an entire system. The software and other system elements are tested as a whole.

mcqs.question: A ________ is tested to ensure that information properly flows into and out of the system.
mcqs.explanation: A module interface is tested to ensure that information properly flows into and out of the system.

mcqs.question: A testing conducted at the developer’s site under validation testing.
mcqs.explanation: Alpha testing is conducted at developer’s site. It is conducted by customer in developer’s presence before software delivery.

links.context: This set of Computer Fundamentals Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Concepts of OOP”.

mcqs.question: A ______________ represents the need of information in the program without the presenting the details.
mcqs.explanation: Abstraction is a concept that involves hiding the details and giving only the necessary information to the user. It increases the power of a programming language.

mcqs.question: Abstraction combines the data and functions into a single unit called a class.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Data abstraction involves hiding the details and giving only the necessary information to the user.

mcqs.question: The process of forming a new class from an existing class.
mcqs.explanation: The answer is inheritance. The base class is the parent class and the new class is called the child class.

mcqs.question: This concept allows routines to use data again at different times.
mcqs.explanation: Polymorphism is a concept in OOP wherein different functions can be used again at different times.

mcqs.question: The ability for programmers to use the same written and debugged existing class.
mcqs.explanation: The programmer can add features to the existing class. The programmer on further developing the application, and allowing users to achieve increased performance.

mcqs.question: A concept that combines data and functions into a single unit called class.
mcqs.explanation: Encapsulation enables the important concept of data hiding possible. It combines data and functions into a single unit.

mcqs.question: __________ represents a particular instance of a class.
mcqs.explanation: An object is an instance of the class. The data members are accessed with the help of objects.

mcqs.question: A basic unit of object-oriented programming.
mcqs.explanation: In OOP, the basic unit is an object. Objects are identified by its unique name.

mcqs.question: A procedural programming follows ___________ approach.
mcqs.explanation: A procedural programming follows top-down approach. The main focus is on the functions. It has a lot of global variable.

mcqs.question: A programming technique in which the focus is on doing things.
mcqs.explanation: In procedural programming, the focus is on doing things(functions). It follows top-down approach.
